thread:
Maria: Heads up — planning to onboard falconx-70b-ext weights tomorrow AM. Uploaded to s3://rwd-models/falconx/70b/extended/v2/ (sha256 sums in the dir).

Josh: Nice. Are those fp16 checkpoints or the quantized bundles? Also which tokenizer file should runtime use?

Maria: Full fp16 + separate int8 and int4 conversion artifacts in /quant. Tokenizer: `falconx_ext_tok_v3.json` (paired). FYI saw weird behavior with U+2014 (em-dash) and some ligatures producing an extra token on split.

Trevor: noted — that ligature->extra-token can bloat seq counts. I tokenized a 10k-word doc with many em-dashes, got +3 tokens per dash in places.

Anita: Core checklist before merge:
- weights path + checksums present
- tokenizer mapping verified against canonical prompts
- model_config validated (max_ctx, kv flags, memory estimates)
- PR with model.json + example runtime config and canary plan

Li: PR submitted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/4377 — includes model.json, tokenizer, and runbook snippet. Need memory sizing sign-off.

Andrew: Quick scan: model.json has `max_context = 65536` which is ambitious. KV cache and per-token k/v storage will spike.

Maria: Target workload is long-document retrieval-augmented QA, usually batch=1, sometimes batch=2. We need to avoid OOM on 48/80/128GB nodes.

qa-bot: longctx-smoke started on staging-gpu-48gb
qa-bot: smoke results: 2/3 passed; case #3 OOM during decode at seq_len=64000, batch=1, kv_bytes growth ~115GB

Trevor: That confirms it. Unless we pack KV or force int4, 48GB cannot hold 65k context for 70b.

Anita: Proposed mitigations:
1) soft runtime cap by deployment tier (e.g., hosted: 32k default, opt-in for >32k)
2) enable `kv_cache: packed` (contiguous per-layer) to reduce fragmentation
3) prefer int4 quantized serving for >32k contexts (with eval gate)

Josh: FYI our runtime flag is `runtime.kv_cache.format` with values `packed` or `per_layer_separate`. PR uses `packed`.

Li: model.json excerpt in PR:
```
"max_context": 65536,
"runtime": {
  "kv_cache": { "format": "packed", "shard": "per_gpu" },
  "quant": { "mode": "int8", "auto_promote": true }
}
```

Andrew: If `auto_promote` allows node-side int4 promotion we can cut mem by ~2x vs int8 — needs accuracy evals.

Maria: Anita — can you run tokenizer sanity across the 25 canonical prompts (include long docs, emojis, CJK snippets)? If any mapping shifts, add a normalization wrapper.

Anita: Starting tokenizer passes now. Will report quick findings.

(12m later)

Anita: Tokenizer sanity: 25/25 mappings stable, but 3 prompts showed +1 token due to em-dash decomposition. Added normalization shim in PR #4378 as a tiny pre-tokenize step.

Trevor: Cool. Memory sims (local): packed + int4 -> ~58GB peak for seq=65k batch=1 on 70b sim. packed + int8 -> ~100GB. separate -> >130GB.

Josh: So mapping to infra:
- hosted (48GB): safe up to ~32k with int4+packed
- dedicated 80GB: can do 65k if int4+packed and batch=1
- 128GB: safe for int8+packed for bursts

Li: Added a note to onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/model-onboard/falconx-70b-ext — includes memory table and suggested SKUs.

Maria: Action items:
- @Anita: open tokenizer shim PR (thanks), then merge once CI passes (ETA today)
- @Andrew: run int4 accuracy eval on eval-harness, target regression <0.6%
- @Trevor: publish final memory sizing table including batch/seq permutations
- @Josh: add runtime gating for max_context per deployment tier and ensure `kv_cache.format` exposed
- @Li: add canary flag to disable >32k contexts in hosted until metrics are green

Andrew: Starting int4 eval now; will share numbers in ~2h.

Maria: If tokenizer + int4 eval pass, we'll merge and roll a canary to staging. Note: do NOT enable longctx in hosted by default until perf/regressions verified :warning:

dev-bot: deploy-plan created: models/falconx-70b-ext -> canary/staging (flag: longctx_disabled_by_default=true)

Maria: Thanks all. Please ack when your checks are complete :rocket:

Anita: ack — tokenizer shim PR opened: #4378

Andrew: ack — int4 eval started, will follow up in thread

Trevor: ack — memory table pushed to the onboarding doc

Li: ack — will flip canary after merges

Maria: Closing loop for now. Will update with canary metrics once available.
